steps.name: audit-field-mvp-history
steps.command: set -eu; git fetch origin main field-mvp-work portfolio/p1-quality-20260827 integration/mvp-cleanup; echo '=== BINDING/BRANCH ==='; git status --short --branch; echo '=== DIVERGENCE ==='; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...origin/field-mvp-work; echo '=== MVP COMMITS OLDEST FIRST ==='; git log --reverse --format='%H%x09%s' origin/main..origin/field-mvp-work; echo '=== FILES PER MVP COMMIT ==='; for c in $(git rev-list --reverse origin/main..origin/field-mvp-work); do echo; git show --no-renames --format='--- %H %s' --name-status --stat --oneline $c; done; echo; echo '=== CURRENT NET DIFF ==='; git diff --stat origin/main...origin/field-mvp-work; git diff --name-status origin/main...origin/field-mvp-work; echo; echo '=== MERGE-TREE CONFLICT PROBE ==='; base=$(git merge-base origin/main origin/field-mvp-work); git merge-tree

origin/main origin/field-mvp-work | grep -E '^(<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>|changed in both|added in both|removed in|CONFLICT)' -C 2 || true; echo; echo '=== QUALITY PR COMMITS ==='; git log --reverse --format='%H%x09%s' origin/main..origin/portfolio/p1-quality-20260827
